item.title: Agentic coding without the cloud: evaluating open-weight large language models on longitudinal data preparation tasks
item.description:
This research solves the problem of securely using large language models for code development with sensitive data by building an open-source framework for evaluating locally deployable open-weight models. The result is an alternative to cloud-based models that can keep sensitive data local. This is relevant for organizations with strict data governance requirements.

IT Breakdown: If you manage infrastructure for research or organizations with sensitive data, here is what to do: consider using locally deployable open-weight large language models, evaluate the open-source framework for your specific use case, and assess the security benefits of keeping data local. This flags a risk: if your org uses cloud-based models for sensitive data, check your data governance policies immediately.

item.title: [News] NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics
item.description: NVIDIA has introduced Cosmos-H-Dreams, a real-time generative simulation tool for surgical robotics. This technology enables doctors to simulate complex surgeries in a highly realistic and dynamic environment.

item.title: [News] Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
item.description: Researchers are exploring the use of brain waves to unlock physical AI models, potentially paving the way for more advanced human-AI collaboration. However, this concept is still in its infancy with multiple camera angles and dense annotation still being required.
